title: Binance Says It Won Court Order to Recover Frozen Hack Funds
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Says It Won Court Order to Recover Frozen Hack Funds Binance says it has a court order from Abu Dhabi Global Market to recover crypto frozen after the $6.3 billion hack. This post Binance Says It Won Court Order to Recover Frozen Hack Funds first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
